# LokTube 1.6.1

- **Audible tabs:** Show a speaker icon on each tab that is actively playing audio at nonzero volume. The indicator responds to pauses, muting, playback loading and tab closure.
- **Cast to TV:** Add a Cast control in the app header. Pair YouTube-enabled TVs or streaming devices through **YouTube → Settings → Link with TV code** and save linked devices for future use.
- **Playback handoff:** Send the current video or song and a bounded playback queue to the YouTube app on the TV, resuming near the local playback position when available. Local playback pauses only after the TV accepts the request.
- **Cast management:** Replay on a linked TV, stop its YouTube playlist, remove saved pairing, refresh expired pairing tokens when supported, and receive clear errors for rejected or unreachable sessions.
- **Reliability:** Add typed Electron IPC, bounded Lounge protocol parsing, request timeouts, validation and unit tests.

**Casting scope:** This version supports YouTube's TV-code pairing mechanism, **not** general Chromecast discovery, AirPlay or screen mirroring. The TV must run the YouTube app. Receiver compatibility and reconnection behavior may vary because the protocol is not public; physical-device validation remains recommended.

Source: [audio indicator and TV casting PR #23](https://github.com/lokal-music/loktube/pull/23).
